themes.title: Javier Milei’s declining approval amid internal strife
themes.blurb: Argentina's President Javier Milei faces a sixth consecutive monthly drop in public approval, with polls showing over 60% disapproval. Internal conflicts within his party, La Libertad Avanza, and tensions with key allies like Patricia Bullrich and Victoria Villarruel dominate coverage across multiple countries, reflecting broader concerns about governance and economic policies.

themes.title: Far-right gains in European local elections
themes.blurb: Far-right and right-wing parties across Europe are making significant gains in local elections, with notable victories in Italy, Spain, and France. These results are framed as a rejection of mainstream politics and a shift toward nationalist, anti-immigration policies, often at the expense of traditional center-right and left-wing parties.

themes.title: Trump’s Iran deal dominates global right-wing coverage
